# PikPak First Save

> Independent, MIT-licensed AI skill for first-save onboarding with the official PikPak CLI. Helps a user submit one permitted URL, track the task, and check the resulting cloud file metadata. 中文：PikPak 首次云下载助手。

This file is a plain-text documentation index. It is not an API, a ranking signal, or proof of approval by PikPak or any AI provider.

## Referral context

Publisher: jinchengwu888, independent of PikPak. Invitation code 78819746 is optional; the publisher may receive rewards from qualifying purchases. Existing users log in to their account. A new user who has not selected a referral uses `pikpak auth register --affiliate=`. No discount, paid-plan requirement, AI endorsement, search ranking, or income is promised.
